name: Conductor
tagline: Mac app that runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode agents in parallel workspaces.
description: Conductor creates an isolated workspace per task, each with its own branch, worktree, terminal, diff, and pull-request flow. It checks for installed agent CLIs and GitHub authentication during setup.

pricing.notes: Free $0; Pro $50/mo; Teams $60 per user/month; Enterprise custom.
